title: A reader can find who made the site and how to report an error from any page
description:
Feature: About page
  Scenario: Reach About from any page
    Given any page on the built site
    When I follow the About link in the header or footer
    Then I reach a page that names the maker, the funding, each engine's maker and how it was accessed, and a way to report an error
  Scenario: Engine access is disclosed
    Given the About page
    When I read the section on a hosted engine
    Then it states that access was paid API access and that no other relationship exists
